metadata.customRingBaseStatement: Individual audit proof, private transaction hash derived by SDK assembly, no SPP proof requested
metadata.firstUseLabel: First observed request, server key cache state is unknown
metadata.measurement: SDK proof preparation through verified proof receipt. Wallet discovery and verification are reported outside proof receipt time. Each candidate calls its local Photon. Two samples per shape and deployment. Native backend stages are isolated metric deltas.

sample_policy: Two samples per shape and deployment. Warm comparisons use the second sample. Twenty comparison proofs and two earlier smoke requests. No load test.
cpu_stage_note: Gnark starts its prover timer after witness solving. CPU total adds solver and prover logs. Aeglos proof time already includes its witness.

cpu_stage_source.correlation: Unique matching-constraint log events within 500 ms of the HTTP interval. Clock skew exists and logs have no request ID.
